section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Other as Shamer Scale (OAS), a self-report instrument with 18 items designed to measure external shame on a 5-point scale. The text reports reliability coefficients from original studies (α=0.92), Portuguese studies (α=0.91), and the present study (α=0.94), but does not provide participant demographics, study design details, or outcome correlations.
